name: Hariph
overview: The name Hariph appears in Scripture as one of the exiles who returned to Jerusalem, with Ezra 2:18 and Nehemiah 7:24 indicating that Hariph is likely the same individual as Jorah or Jora, highlighting a textual variant in the genealogical records. Additionally, Nehemiah 10:19 includes Hariph among those who sealed the covenant, demonstrating his role in reaffirming the community's commitment to God's law during the post-exilic restoration.
